body.name: \((c_{\eta},A_{\eta,t,F},d_{\eta},b_{\eta,t,F})\)
body.construction: Order the \(o\) observed cells and the \(r=|\mathcal R_{Y_{\star}}|\) outcome-row classes. Expand the finite latent sums using \(G\), the quotient \(\mathcal R\), the retained trace \(t\), its displayed forest \(F\), and the fixed nuisance table \(\eta\). Let \(J_{t,F}\) be the outcome-row classes reached by a root-to-‑\(Y_{\star}\) path inside the displayed forest and set all columns outside \(J_{t,F}\) to zero. Define \(c_{\eta}=F_{\eta}(0)\), \((A_{\eta,t,F})_{vj}=\mathbf 1\{j\in J_{t,F}\}\{F_{\eta}(e_j)_v-F_{\eta}(0)_v\}\), \(d_{\eta}=h_{\eta}(0)\), and \((b_{\eta,t,F})_j=\mathbf 1\{j\in J_{t,F}\}\{h_{\eta}(e_j)-h_{\eta}(0)\}\). Hence the restricted perturbation \(u\) has observed increment \(A_{\eta,t,F}u\) and query increment \(b_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}u\). These coefficients are recomputed from the graph, quotient, retained forest trace, and fixed slice nuisance; neither observed-cell values nor countermodels are inputs.
